harmonicFunction: G (I) - Tonic major chord anchored by open high strings
D/F# (V6) - First inversion dominant chord initiating the descending bass step
F (bVII) - Borrowed Mixolydian flat-seventh chord continuing chromatic root descent
C/E (IV6) - Inverted subdominant chord providing smooth stepwise connection to Eb
Ebmaj7 (bVImaj7) - Sublime modal interchange chord adding lush, bittersweet tension

techniques.name: Jazz-Inflected Chromatic Acoustic Walkdown
techniques.description: Dean DeLeo's signature voicings: descending bassline on the 6th and 5th strings while keeping open 3rd (G) and 2nd (B) strings ringing as continuous drone tones

sequence: Fret G with thumb or 2nd finger on 6th string 3rd fret
Walk down to 6th string 2nd fret (F#) for D/F#
Move to 6th string 1st fret (F) for F chord
Drop to open 6th string E for C/E, then shift to 5th string 6th fret for Ebmaj7
tips: Keep the tempo steady at 72 BPM to let the rich chord substitutions resonate
Use thumb-over technique on the low E string if comfortable for smooth transitions
Let open strings ring freely throughout the chromatic descent

beginner.title: Master the Chromatic Walkdown
steps: Practice moving between G and D/F# (thumb or 2nd finger on 6th string 2nd fret)
Connect smoothly from F to C/E
Play the verse cycle at 60 BPM

intermediate.title: Solidify Timing and Dynamics
steps: Bring verse walkdown up to album tempo of 72 BPM
Practice the chorus chord shifts (D → C → G → Eb → F)
Maintain ringing open drones throughout chord changes

advanced.title: Full Soulful Vocal & Acoustic Performance
steps: Deliver Scott Weiland's gritty, emotive vocal phrasing
Perform the complete MTV Headbangers Ball acoustic arrangement
Execute dynamic builds with effortless rock presence

commonMistakes: Rushing the slow 72 BPM tempo — the groove needs spacious ballad sway

Fumbling the shift into the Ebmaj7 barre shape
